name: Overturn
description: Overturn for Front: captures what the AI drafted, what the agent sent, and why, as a replayable case

settings.name: overturn_api_key
settings.description: A project API key from Overturn (Settings → API keys).

settings.name: overturn_base_url
settings.description: Your Overturn API URL when self-hosting.

settings.name: agent
settings.description: The workflow name. One regression suite per workflow.

settings.name: require_reason
settings.description: Block the send until the agent picks a reason when they changed the draft.

settings.name: decision_fields
settings.description: Custom fields that are the decision, as id:label pairs.

settings.name: scope_tag
settings.description: Optional tag name. Only conversations carrying this tag are watched.

settings.name: min_draft_chars
settings.description: Text inserted into the reply box at least this long counts as the draft.
